title: PLI SCHEME FOR AUTOMOBILE AND AUTO COMPONENTS AND BATTERY STORAGE
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Heavy Industries

PLI SCHEME FOR AUTOMOBILE AND AUTO COMPONENTS AND BATTERY STORAGE

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 5:08PM by PIB Delhi

Government approved the PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry in India (PLI-Auto) with a budgetary outlay of Rs.25,938 crore for enhancing India’s manufacturing capabilities for Advanced Automotive Products (AAT) on 23/09/2021. The status of implementation of PLI-Auto scheme across all states are as below:-

Parameter

Cumulative till 31.03.2026

Investment (Rs. crore)

44,326

Employment generated (Nos.)

67,820

Incentive disbursed (Rs. in cr)

2,386.36



Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme on “National Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage”, approved in May 2021, with an outlay of ₹18,100 Crore for 50 GWh capacity. Till date, no beneficiary firm has claimed any incentive under the PLI ACC scheme. As reported by the beneficiary firms, the scheme has attracted an investment of ₹5,180 crore and direct employment of 1,277 till 31.05.2026.

PLI Auto is a pan-India Scheme and approved applicants are free to set up units anywhere in the country. State-wise distribution (incl Tamil Nadu) of units set up under PLI Auto is as follows:
